rows.title: Cannes Review: Jacques Audiard’s Emilia Perez is an Audaciously Bad Dud
rows.comment: Emilia Perez is a blend of inspired cinematic technique and stereotypically cool music-video aesthetics
rows.verdict_le10: Emilia Perez is a blend of inspired cinematic technique and stereotypically cool music-video aesthetics
rows.dek_lead: At its strongest, Emilia Perez is a blend of inspired cinematic technique and stereotypically cool music-video aesthetics. And even at that, it’s a flashy slog at two hours and ten minutes.
